flags.summary: Pidlwick II, the clockwork jester, came down the high tower stair to greet the party (spires_pidlwick:first).
The party played catch with Pidlwick II on the stair (spires_pidlwick:play).
A failed Insight check on Pidlwick II: he won't talk about the first Pidlwick again (the portrait or Escher still lead to the truth).
The party knows Pidlwick II pushed the first Pidlwick, the jester he was built to copy, down the high tower stair.
Pidlwick II promised to walk behind the party on stairs, always (spires_pidlwick:cards_truth).
The party refused to take Pidlwick II along. If the cards named him, find_the_ally is lost.
The party found Pidlwick II's brass wind-up key in a ravens' nest under the roofs (spires_roost:brass).
The party wound Pidlwick II with his own key (spires_pidlwick:key_back); he asks to come along.
The party looked at the portrait of the first Pidlwick on the grand landing (prop spires_jester_portrait).
The party met Escher, Strahd's cast-off consort, in his locked suite (spires_escher:first).
The party promised Escher to leave his door open once Strahd is gone; he paid with his ring and told them about the heart.
The party paid Escher in gold for what he knows about the heart.
A failed Persuasion on Escher: his price for the heart doubles to 200 gp.
The party frightened Escher into talking (Intimidation). He turns them away afterwards.
Escher told the party what the heart at the top of the high tower is.
Escher told the party how the first Pidlwick died and who stood at the top of the stair.
The party destroyed Escher (encounter escher_fight).
The party knows the crystal heart at the top of the high tower takes Strahd's wounds before he does (Escher, Pidlwick, Arcana or a cleric).
The party has stood before the Heart of Sorrow (spires_heart:heart).
The high tower's guardians that came to defend the heart are destroyed (encounter heart_guardians); the next blow breaks it.

THE HEART OF SORROW IS BROKEN (spires_heart:shatter). Strahd loses the heart's ward: the final battles and the coffin fight should read it (no 50 extra hit points). Strahd's parley and the epilogue may read it too.
Strahd came up the high tower as mist after the heart broke, fought one round and withdrew (encounter heart_strahd_test, its withdraw flag).
The marionette card's final battle at the Heart of Sorrow was fought (encounter heart_of_sorrow_final).
The stair's sentries on the upper turns of the high tower are destroyed (encounter spires_stair_watch).
The party found the narrow stair behind Escher's wardrobe (search prop spires_wardrobe_seam).
Escher or Pidlwick II told the party about the narrow stair behind Escher's wardrobe; the way to the roost opens.
The witches at the cauldron in the tower rooms are dead (encounter cauldron_coven).
The stone guardians of the north tower peak are destroyed (encounter peak_guardians).
The ravens in the roost accept the party (friendship, food or Animal Handling); opening the great nest no longer starts a fight.
The party fought the ravens of the roost (roost_swarm or roost_swarm_roused).
